title: Passage 28
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: People know animals do have feelings.
sentences.cn: 人们知道动物确实是有情感的。

sentences.en: Scientists have done research about the feelings of cows, frogs and pandas.
sentences.cn: 科学家们已经对奶牛、青蛙和大熊猫的情感进行了研究。

sentences.en: A new study adds chickens to the list.
sentences.cn: 而一项新的研究将鸡也列入了研究范畴。

sentences.en: We know that during a storm with thunder and lightning,
sentences.cn: 我们知道，在雷电交加的暴风雨中，

sentences.en: these animals get shocked and stay close together near the bottom of the barn.
sentences.cn: 这些动物会受惊，并紧紧聚集在畜棚底部附近。

sentences.en: But what do they say?
sentences.cn: 但它们会说些什么呢？

sentences.en: It seems that humans can tell whether hens and roosters are happy or sad by listening to their calls,
sentences.cn: 似乎人类可以通过听母鸡和公鸡的叫声来判断它们是高兴还是悲伤，

sentences.en: just like hearing other people say "hello" or "goodbye" with different tones.
sentences.cn: 就像听到其他人用不同语气说“你好”或“再见”一样。

sentences.en: The researchers put a bowl behind a door.
sentences.cn: 研究人员在门后放了一个碗。

sentences.en: Sometimes, there was something chickens love to eat in the bowl, such as rice, sweet porridge or insects.
sentences.cn: 有时，碗里有鸡爱吃的东西，比如大米、甜粥或昆虫。

sentences.en: Sometimes, the bowl was empty.
sentences.cn: 而有时，碗里是空的。

sentences.en: Chickens that saw food seemed happy and produced fast and loud sounds,
sentences.cn: 看到食物的鸡似乎很高兴，会发出又快又响亮的叫声，

sentences.en: which they also do when playing with a new toy.
sentences.cn: 它们在玩新玩具时也会这样。

sentences.en: Chickens that saw an empty bowl made low and long noises to express disappointment.
sentences.cn: 而看到空碗的鸡，则会发出低沉而悠长的叫声来表达失望。

sentences.en: The researchers recorded all these sounds and studied their waves.
sentences.cn: 研究人员录下了所有声音，并研究了它们的声波。

sentences.en: The researchers played 16 recordings of such chicken noises to 194 volunteers.
sentences.cn: 研究人员向194名志愿者播放了16段鸡叫声的录音。

sentences.en: Half were from the chickens seeing the food, and half were from the chickens finding no food.
sentences.cn: 其中一半是鸡看到食物时发出的声音，另一半是鸡发现没有食物时发出的声音。

sentences.en: Sixty-nine per cent of the volunteers correctly understood the chickens' emotions.
sentences.cn: 69%的志愿者都正确理解了鸡的情绪。

sentences.en: The result shows that humans have the natural ability to understand the feelings of chickens.
sentences.cn: 这个结果表明，人类天生有理解鸡的情感的能力。

sentences.en: Hopefully, this finding can bring about new technology to help bosses of farms in raising chickens,
sentences.cn: 这一发现有望带来新技术来帮助农场主养鸡，

sentences.en: a big industry in many countries.
sentences.cn: 这在许多国家都是一个庞大的产业。

sentences.en: Scientists are working on a smart computer program that can identify chickens' feelings.
sentences.cn: 科学家们正在研究一个可以识别鸡的情感的智能计算机程序。

sentences.en: Good news for farmers who want to make the birds happier and healthier.
sentences.cn: 这对那些希望让鸡更快乐、更健康的农场主们来说是个好消息。
